facts.text: Eat something, pal. Nobody does honest crime on an empty stomach.
facts.why: No Oz line like this appears on the quote pages opened. The only Oz line found is 'Just look at you! World's Greatest Detectives!'
facts.fix: Just look at you! World's Greatest Detectives!

fix_note.text: Just look at you! World's Greatest Detectives!

facts.text: Alfred keeping Bruce going in the old Wayne Tower.
facts.why: Bruce lives in the old Wayne Tower in this film, Alfred is his butler and caretaker, and the script has Alfred fussing over his cufflinks and appearances there.

facts.text: Selina's shift ends downstairs at 44 Below.
facts.why: Selina says she just works the bar upstairs at the Iceberg Lounge. No place called 44 Below is named.
facts.fix: Selina's shift ends at the Iceberg Lounge, upstairs bar.

facts.text: Selina Kyle and the cats in her apartment
facts.why: When Bruce visits her place he says 'You got a lot of cats' and she says she has a thing about strays.

vibe.verdict: The Iceberg Lounge setting and the Riddler's cards are on target, but the rain, riddles and the Gotham flood are barely used.
